generatorSupport.notes: EXPERIMENTAL Pollux target (SPEC-008): standalone CRUD over the v2 API via the 'tanstack-start' adapter. File-based routing means generated pages register themselves through the framework's route tree (tsr generate / vite plugin) — only the sidebar uses a generated nav fragment glob. PKCE/BFF auth via the shared bff-core; the proxy forwards the interim server-only POLLUX_DEV_BEARER credential when no access cookie exists. Canonical verification: tsr generate before tsc.
